title: CULT.AF.B.------POL.P.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-5. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'The distortions that have crept into western analysis can be viewed by understanding the essence premise that dictates its information degrees.' The crossing diagrams how cultural-affinity base structurally meets political-particulars at the western-analysis scale: CULT-AF-B crossed with POL-P. CULT-AF-B sits at lower-right with the subject-arrow; POL-P at upper-right as partner-axis. PROJ-DY (projection dynamics), AF-NT (affinity natural), (R)INTR (reality of introduction) upper-center to upper-right. INFO-F (information form), RTD-PRD (rooted-period) center. T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication), WO-EXP-PR (world exposure principle) at left. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), POL-DY (political dynamics), LK-IMP (linkage implication) at lower-center.
